## Professional fit

Scott is a strong fit for Senior MarTech Architect, Adobe Experience Platform Architect, Principal AEP Consultant, Customer Data Platform Architect, Analytics Solution Architect, and MarTech Solution Architect roles.

Core expertise includes Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics, Web SDK, Mobile SDK, XDM schema design, identity resolution, customer profile strategy, consent management, data governance, personalization, analytics engineering, Tealium iQ, Google Tag Manager, SQL, Python, and JavaScript.
